scope: C04 primary reference: place, navigation and environmental response
C10 primary reference: sound, music and state response
method: Element-specific public evidence was separated into developer design records, independent professional criticism, player discussion and later retrospective/continuation evidence. Contrary evidence was retained. These sources select references only and are not candidate gameplay or blind-comparison material.

results.selection: four axes substantiated for the primary reference
positiveBasis: Independent criticism specifically connects wind navigation, animals, weather, scenery and score to one readable place experience.
Developer design evidence explains environment-wide reaction of foliage, cloth and particles to navigation wind and cinematic tension.
Player discussion supports looking at and reasoning about the world instead of a corner minimap.
A 2025 sequel interview still treats wind navigation as central and memorable.
counterevidence: Some players report losing objectives without a minimap or prefer conventional waypoints.
The original navigation vector did not route around large obstacles such as cliffs.
A later review identifies static environmental and dated presentation aspects.
remaining: Complete the separate four-axis selection of supplementary SK for compact place structure.
Acquire actual matched uninterrupted media and perform valid source-blind comparison.

results.selection: four axes substantiated for the primary reference
positiveBasis: Professional awards specifically recognize sound design, foley and music.
Independent criticism praises the score as part of the world presentation.
Production records establish field-recorded environmental ambience rather than a generic soundtrack claim.
A 2025 specialist interview retains combat physicality and emotionally continuous mixing as design strengths.
counterevidence: Player discussion includes sparse or forgettable music and repetitive confrontation cues.
The later audio team identifies static loops, fixed sound positions and one-point impact playback in the original as weaknesses.
remaining: Acquire actual matched uninterrupted approach, tension, sword and post-combat ambience media and perform valid source-blind comparison.

formalVerdictReason: No candidate/reference source-blind comparison was performed. Reference-selection research cannot assign a game-element verdict.

verification.result: PASS: 10 units, 16 legacy groups, 62 legacy criteria, six negative checks, fixed instruction text unchanged
